sloka: तेषां युद्धं महारौद्रं सञ्जज्ञे हरिरक्षसाम् ।रामरावणयोरर्थे समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् ।। ६.५५.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ yuddhaṁ mahāraudraṁ sañjajñe harirakṣasām ।rāmarāvaṇayorarthe samabhityaktajīvinām ।। 6.55.15 ।।।।

translations.english: Vanaras and Rakshasas dedicated their lives for Rama and Ravana, respectively in that way were enraged and battle took place.
